answer: GG18 lets a meadow of key holders sign with ECDSA without ever reconstructing the private key, using multiplicative-to-additive share conversion and zero-knowledge proofs at each step. The terrace of the protocol is that every partial signature is verified before combination, so a malicious shareholder cannot slip in a bad share. One account means one signing quorum, and a saffron of fresh accounts still cannot pool enough shares to impersonate anyone.
